text_block_list.name: Shakur's LANE
text_block_list.text:
"Assemble at the school-side bleachers in 
30 minutes. That is all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur suddenly called me out. The 
fact that she didn't mention what it's 
about must mean I'll understand right away 
once I get there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two over there are about to run a 
practice race.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Well then Doto, is your throat ready?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing on the track was T.M. Opera O, 
who had been unleashing her explosive 
talent in top form since entering the 
Senior Class, and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes—throat, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Possessing strength to rival T.M. Opera O, 
Meisho Doto vigilantly(?) watches for an 
opportunity to win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are the top two leading the current 
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa... I'm so sorryyy...! My 
throat isn't ready at allll~!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what a shame. There is quite a large 
audience today. I was thinking of singing 
a song to cap off the race, but..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I need honey right now—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Zuhyan!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you're in top form! Come on 
back, Doto—let's begin!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah! Yaaaaa~~~~...h!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible... It's like a real race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming, breathtaking presence... 
The running form of the two strongest 
current racers seemed to grow sharper and 
more refined with each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae" determined that I'd suffer a 
crushing defeat at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There are several factors, but... The 
biggest one is those guys— the generation 
ahead of us standing as a wall.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everyone of our generation in this 
category, including me, is sinking without 
even catching a glimpse of their shadows.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And then the younger generation bursts 
onto the scene, only to overtake me in no 
time too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's the birth of the "weakest 
generation."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The 'best route' for the Senior Year, see. 
—It's that you can't win.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae" predicts that after the Kikuka 
Sho, I won't win a single race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems that what made back then "the 
worst" went beyond simple wins and 
losses—it also included the public 
perception surrounding her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause my destiny changed doesn't 
mean they've gotten any weaker.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I already know their strength from their 
insane stats. A cozy one-two finish 
between the two of them... Anyone could 
see that coming."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If this were a game, I'd dodge it, grind 
some levels, and try again later, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"There's no time for that kind of leisure 
in racing. Your physical peak passes in 
the blink of an eye."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Instead of that 7 cm, now we gotta take 
down a boss-level monster.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This is seriously a trash game, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I guessed right. Am I starting 
to understand her a little better... 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. Either way, our winning 
condition from here on is simple.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll crush every single one of them. Then 
I'll automatically take the top spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She'll advance to the Senior Class right 
after the Japan Cup. It seems she's shared 
an outline of how she plans to race from 
there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once I stand at the top... everyone will 
know who the real deal is, like it or not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words showed a clear grasp of her 
current reality. Air Shakur had run 
through the Classic Triple Crown races 
with spectacular results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, public evaluation hasn't really 
picked up. She must be analyzing the 
reason why. And if her conclusion is that 
she needs to beat everyone at the top—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur might still feel that she lacks 
absolute, overwhelming victories. If 
that's the case, then to those girls...
choice_data_list:
I hope they become an even taller wall to 
overcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
It's better if breaking it makes a bigger 
impact.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, perhaps... it might bring 
fame worthy of the Triple Crown, or 
perhaps even greater."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
... I'm gonna be in trouble if you get any 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You saw what they're capable of, right? 
I've already finished the analysis. All 
that's left is the training—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's lacking. Something is missing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Opera O-san?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've got it, Doto! —It's your 
metamorphosis!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Meta...? Metaa?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For the next Japan Cup, I want to take 
things to the next level... and make it an 
even more thrilling stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If you, my rival, undergo further 
evolution... dancing like a butterfly and 
closing in on me, the crowd will surely go 
wild—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It shall fantastically embellish the 
ending where I sting like a bee. Yes, you 
are the one who holds the key!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san... But I—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Can you make it, Doto? All the way to my 
throat.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...? What's with this atmosphere...?

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaah! Uuuwaaaaaa~~~~...h!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“You've gotta be kidding me. Those guys... 
are pulling away even more.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter how much of a monster they 
are, everyone has a ceiling."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The rest is like a puzzle. Honing and 
stacking skills, controlling the pace to 
enforce your own style... There are plenty 
of ways to seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However... don't tell me, she broke past 
her limits at this exact moment?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So easily, just like that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur stared blankly for a while at 
the two of them after they finished 
running.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Gotta go. I need to recalculate, 
factoring this in too."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What are you even worried about?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I already know what I gotta do. Push 
myself to theoretical perfection, and win 
just as envisioned. Same as always, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
What do you wish for now, and why do you 
run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Changing the nightmare of the 7cm made the 
future of the Senior Class a blank slate. 
From here on, what will Air Shakur run 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? ...Victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Victory is the absolute solution. Who 
could possibly disprove its correctness?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep proving I'm right... all 
that annoying noise will fade away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I'll snatch away all their 
props by the roots. That's all there is to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fall at the Japan Cup. 
That piece-of-crap destiny has already 
changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as if... I'd ever go down in a place 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—There she is. The poster child of the 
'Weakest Generation,' Air Shakur. Guess 
she really can't compete with those above 
or below her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. It's not like I was strong, 
after all. I just got lucky..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I fell asleep...! Gotta wrap this 
up quick—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzt, bzzzt...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"How about some shio ramen! One free bowl 
right now♪" ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzt, bzzzt, bzzzt Bzz-bzz-bzz-bzz...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aargh, so damn noisy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This is no damn time to be eating. Even 
if I'm outmatched, I sure as hell ain't 
gonna get crushed...)
